subject: Suitability debrief + Redwood-verified perf profiles, prompt suite and next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clarity.ai>, Leah Kim <leah@clarity.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Suitability debrief + Redwood-verified perf profiles, prompt suite and next steps

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — quick consolidated debrief and suggested runway so your eng/ops teams can evaluate infra tradeoffs. I pulled together Redwood-verified performance profiles and a small prompt set that reproduces the request patterns we discussed. Attachments: clarity_benchmarks_v1.zip (perf traces + sample payloads), prompt-pack-clarity-v1.json (prompt variants & eval queries).

High-level recommendation (based on your traffic shape: many short chat turns, 98th pct tokens ~ 80):
- Pilot model lane: RW-GPT-13B-q4 (quantized) — best cost/latency balance for short-turn chat and high concurrent sessions.
- Fallback lane for complex instructions: Llama-3-70B-8k (float16) — higher quality on long-form but ~3x token cost.

Redwood-verified profiles (link below) — canonical throughput and latency snapshots (median/p95/p99) we measured on Dedicated A100-equivalent pools with continuous batching tuned to your concurrency: 
- RW-GPT-13B-q4: TPS (tokens/s) = 460; latency p50 = 18ms/token, p95 = 110ms/token, p99 = 230ms/token; median end-to-end response for avg 40-token reply = ~0.9s.
- Llama-3-70B-8k: TPS = 85; latency p50 = 65ms/token, p95 = 420ms/token, p99 = 950ms/token; median 120-token reply = ~3.1s.
- Mistral-Infer-7B (opt): TPS = 380; latency p50 = 22ms/token, p95 = 140ms/token, p99 = 340ms/token; good mid-point for mixed workloads.

Quality/regression notes (what to watch for):
- Quantization artifacts: RW-GPT-13B-q4 shows rare token-level repetition on very long context windows (>2k tokens). We included guardrail prompts and an automated regression test (in prompt-pack) to detect this.
- Prompt sensitivity: some of your instruction templates (see markers in prompt-pack) push hallucination risk when references to external docs are ambiguous — we recommend the short context-priming pattern attached.

Pilot proposal & next steps:
1) Share the attachments with your SRE + ML infra team (included) and run the perf traces against your expected concurrency. Link to Redwood perf portal: https://redwood.ai/perf/CLAR-2026-03/profiles
2) We can stand up a 2-week Dedicated pilot (reserved 4x A100-eq slots) to reproduce these profiles on your data/latency SLOs. Redwood will enable KV-prefix caching and tuned batching for the pilot.
3) We’ll run the prompt-pack test suite and push an initial quality baseline; if we see regressions on quantized lane we can flip to Mistral-Infer-7B for those flows.

Asks for your team: please confirm the expected concurrent sessions (estimate) and whether 99% latency target is 2s or 4s for short-turn chat flows. Once you confirm, Marcus and I will map the pilot sizing and provide an estimate.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad

Appreciate the thorough recap, Mina — this is exactly the kind of detail we need. Quick answers:
- Concurrent sessions: initial pilot ~250 active sessions with expected bursts to 600 during peak.
- 99% latency target: 2s for the short-turn chat flow; longer jobs (batch summarization) can be relaxed.

We'll download the attachments and share with infra. Can you also surface a quick cost delta (ballpark) between RW-GPT-13B-q4 pilot vs Llama-3-70B-8k for the 2-week pilot? Even a per-hour estimate is enough for budgeting.

— Sanjay

- Llama-3-70B-8k lane: ~ $26,000 — higher GPU/runtime cost due to model size and memory needs.

If you want to reduce cost we can suggest a hybrid pilot: provide RW-GPT-13B-q4 for short-turn routing and auto-failover to Llama-3-70B for complex tasks. Hi Sanjay / Leah — looping in a short-sizing summary so you have what you need to greenlight infra procurement.

Sizing assumptions (from your traffic & our convo):
- Peak concurrent sessions (target for pilot): 600
- Average reply length: 40 tokens; tail workflows up to 250 tokens
- Target 99% P95 latency target: 2s end-to-end for short-turn chat

Recommended pilot config to meet SLOs with 10% cushion:
- RW-GPT-13B-q4 lane: 4 reserved A100-eq GPUs with continuous batching + prefix KV cache. Expected steady-state concurrency: ~420 active sessions with headroom for bursts.
- Llama-3-70B-8k lane (failover/longer jobs): 2 reserved A100-eq GPUs to handle complex flows and regression checks.

Operational notes:
- We'll enable tracing and token-level cost dashboards in the Redwood Console for the pilot so you can watch per-route latency and token spend.
- Prompt-pack includes regression checks that run nightly against a sampled set of user queries; if quantized lane fails baseline quality metrics (ROUGE/semantic similarity thresholds), we auto-flag and failover to Llama-3-70B for flagged queries.

Next actions I can take this week:
1) Share a formal pilot quote (per-hour and total 2-week cost).
2) Provision the reserved pilot environment and share the perf dashboard links.
3) Run the prompt-pack baseline versus your sample dataset (you can upload to the shared Drive link).

If that sounds good, confirm and I'll send the quote by EOD.

— Marcus
